description.text: A Japanese gift box released on 4 December 1998 with two ready-to-play 60-card decks, the Red Deck and the Green Deck, named after the original Pocket Monsters Red and Green games, and a playmat, damage counters, poison markers and coins to play with. Most of the cards reprint ones first sold on the vending-machine sheets, but on non-glossy card and with no rarity mark; Scyther, Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres and Master Ball are holo.
